entries.7052db31a36ce9eb: The corporate philosophy sets out a mission of 'Bringing health and happiness to people around the world through fish' and a vision of 'Protecting fish-eating culture and contributing to the development of Japan's marine products industry'. Its basic management strategy is to become a comprehensive 'fish' company active in Japan and overseas, leveraging its strengths in fresh fish procurement and sales capabilities and the credibility built through its track record. Building on its core domestic business, it is expanding overseas, and under the medium-term management plan (fiscal 2024–2026) it is working to grow its domestic business and expand its overseas business.

entries.e1de78946644a76b: The company's strengths are its fresh fish procurement and sales capabilities. While using Toyosu Market as a procurement base, it sells mainly fresh raw fish shipped directly from production areas, with an assortment of approximately 200 to 300 items at all times at an average store, emphasizing freshness and value for money. In logistics, it is working on reviews such as moving the collection point for some products to the Saitama Prefecture Fish Market (Kita Ward, Saitama City).
entries.e33710be71c51fa8: This business opens as a tenant mainly in station buildings, department stores and supermarkets in the Tokyo metropolitan area, selling fresh fish and sushi to general consumers. Its subsidiary Mogami Sengyo Co., Ltd. opens mainly in supermarkets in the Kyushu region, and its equity-method affiliate CP-Uoriki Co.,Ltd. has stores in large shopping malls in Thailand, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥38,228 million.

entries.e64a59be51071852: As the business environment, the company explains that in Japan, fish prices are rising and supply is declining, consumers are shifting to meat and other foods, and changing tastes are reducing opportunities to eat fish.
